prompt: Single continuous shot. Opens mid-action: black peppercorns crushed under the flat of a knife with a sharp crack, fragments scattering in macro, then toasting in a dry pan until smoke wisps rise. Spaghetti dragged straight from the pot into the pan, cloudy pasta water splashing in and bubbling through the pepper. Money shot: off the heat, a storm of grated pecorino worked into the strands with fast tong swirls — the cheese and starch transforming into a pale creamy veil that clings to every noodle, lifted high in macro with the cream sheeting between strands, steam backlit. Final beat: the nest twirled tall on a plate, one last crack of pepper falling. Warm light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the peppercorn crack, then the tong swirls. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
